# Chad Thurman — Director of Photography & Underwater Cinematographer

> Official production archive, verified industry credits, and cinematography portfolio for Chad Thurman. Based on the North Shore of Oahu, Hawaii. Specializing in high-framerate ocean/underwater imagery, action cinematography, and commercial direction.

## Verified Film & Production Credits
- **Freak Show** (Action Surf Film): Director (Diretor) — Officially cataloged alongside Jamie O'Brien (Edição).
- **You May Not Kiss the Bride** (Feature Film): Production Photographer — Camera & Electrical Department (Shot on location in Hawaii).
- **Hawaii NARC-O** (Episodic Action Series): Director, DP, and Lead Producer.
- **Ocean & Aquatic Cinematography**: Specialist in high-speed surf tracking, wave interiors (Pipeline / North Shore), and specialized underwater camera housing rigs.

## Core Capabilities
- **Underwater Cinematography**: High-speed slow motion, natural and illuminated ocean conditions.
- **Commercial & Narrative DP**: Commercials, music videos, and action sports.
- **Location Packages**: Comprehensive Hawaii location production support, aerials, and multi-camera coordination.
